Beyond the course list

  • Overall GPA At least 2.0 overall GPA.
  • Graduation application Submit the degree completion application during the final anticipated semester.
  • Major course grades At least C in upper-level courses in the major.

Liberty’s transfer rules

  • Up to 90 semester credits from other sources can count toward the 120-credit degree.
  • At least 30 semester credits must be completed at Liberty.
  • At least 30 semester credits must be upper-level.

Questions

Does Study.com College Composition I transfer to Liberty University?

Liberty’s published transfer guidance lists Study.com College Composition I for ENGL 101 Composition and Rhetoric (3 semester credits) in the History (B.S.), with conditions. Ask Liberty to confirm it for your transcript before you pay for the course.

Does Study.com Public Speaking transfer to Liberty University?

Liberty’s published transfer guidance lists Study.com Public Speaking for COMS 101 Speech Communication (3 semester credits) in the History (B.S.), with conditions. Ask Liberty to confirm it for your transcript before you pay for the course.

Does Study.com College Algebra transfer to Liberty University?

Liberty’s published transfer guidance lists Study.com College Algebra for MATH 121 College Algebra (3 semester credits) in the History (B.S.), with conditions. Ask Liberty to confirm it for your transcript before you pay for the course.

How many credits can I transfer into Liberty University’s History (B.S.)?

Liberty’s published limit for this 120-credit degree is 90 semester credits from other sources. At least 30 semester credits must be completed at Liberty. This plan proposes 75 semester credits through outside courses.

Which courses must I take at Liberty University?

In this plan, 45 semester credits are taken at Liberty, including UNIV 104 Instructional Technology for Successful Online Learning, RLGN 104 Christian Life and Biblical Worldview, BIBL 104 Survey of Old and New Testament, THEO 104 Introduction to Theology Survey, GEOG 200 Introduction to Geography and HIST 491 Senior Capstone Seminar and 8 more. Liberty requires at least 30 semester credits at Liberty.

Has Liberty University confirmed this plan?

Not yet. Some course matches or open choices in this plan still need Liberty’s confirmation. Questions to ask: Ask the school whether your state changes the general-education requirements in this plan. Check the provider’s current enrollment terms for 12 outside courses before you enroll. Admission and your transcript evaluation are always Liberty’s decisions.
